propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust the bounded request budget without banking any criterion verdicts, violating the incremental banking contract and returning CompletionRecoveryError instead of evidence-backed PASS/FAIL

Pydantic AI executes tool batches concurrently within a single model response, allowing the model to defer all record_criterion_verdict calls until after budget exhaustion when prompt-only guidance cannot enforce serial banking

The completion-only tool policy wrapper must atomically claim one governed repository action per response step and invoke provisional met=false recording at the third evidence response if a criterion remains unbanked, guaranteeing forward progress

The policy enforcement layer must compose between existing memo/steering toolsets and runaway guard, using a shared lock and live bank-state detection to reject concurrent same-response repository actions while maintaining finalized decision boundaries

System-prompt guidance must be affirmative and finite—process criteria in order, limit evidence responses to three, commit via record tool, then advance—separate from untrusted manifest data and unenforceable by prompt wording alone
